title: BorgWarner Recognized on Newsweek's World's Most Trustworthy Companies 2026 List
summary: Read and download our latest press releases.
body_markdown:
*Auburn Hills, Michigan, September 14, 2026* – BorgWarner has been recognized on Newsweek's World's Most Trustworthy Companies 2026 list for the third consecutive year. This award is presented by Newsweek in partnership with Statista Inc. BorgWarner ranked 36th in the Automotive & Components industry category. The full list can be viewed on[Newsweek.com](https://rankings.newsweek.com/worlds-most-trustworthy-companies-2026) .


"Trust is earned over time and maintained through consistent actions, and it is one of the most valuable assets a company can attain," said Joseph Fadool, President and CEO, BorgWarner Inc. "Being recognized on Newsweek's World's Most Trustworthy Companies list for the third consecutive year is an honor and reflects the confidence our customers, employees and investors place in BorgWarner, as well as our ongoing commitment to operating with integrity. We remain focused on building the lasting relationships that drive resilience and long-term success."


The World's Most Trustworthy Companies 2026 ranking highlights organizations that have earned the confidence of all stakeholders. The ranking was developed through a comprehensive evaluation process that included independent survey responses from more than 65,000 participants across 20 countries, generating approximately 200,000 company evaluations, as well as a social listening analysis of more than 320,000 media mentions. Companies were assessed across three key dimensions of trust: customer trust, employee trust and investor trust.


The overall score was weighted based on survey results (80%) and social listening analysis (20%). The final ranking recognizes 1,000 companies worldwide that have demonstrated the ability to build and maintain trust among key stakeholders.


At BorgWarner, integrity is one of the company's core Beliefs and guides its approach to business. Through strong leadership, transparent governance practices and responsible operations, the company continues to advance its sustainability strategy while supporting long-term value creation for all of its stakeholders.
